payload.name: Current-activity title retrieval
payload.description: When a question asks what a person is reading, watching, listening to, or playing (e.g., 'What novel is X reading?'), include activity-specific query variants and run a structured event search for that predicate before answering no information.
content: When the question asks what a person is reading, watching, listening to, or playing (e.g., 'What novel is X reading?'), include query variants that pair the person's name with the activity verb and the object type: 'reading novel', 'watching show', 'listening to album', 'playing game'.

If the initial hybrid search does not surface a memory with a specific title, run one structured search filtered to memory_kind=event, subject=<person>, and predicate in (read, watch, listen, play) before answering 'No information available'.
Stop after that structured search returns no relevant memory; do not expand to unrelated activities or topics.

solves: When a question asks what a person is currently reading, watching, listening to, or playing, the initial generic search often fails to surface the specific title because the memory may be combined with unrelated content or the predicate is not matched. This skill ensures activity-specific retrieval is performed before concluding no information.
